name: KromiumLogSeverity
description: Log severity levels for the Chromium engine. Controls the verbosity of native CEF log output written to the Kromium log file.
whenToUse: Set via KromiumLoggingConfig when building KromiumConfig to control native log verbosity. Use DISABLE in production to suppress all native logging, or VERBOSE during debugging to capture full Chromium internals.

variants.name: DEFAULT
variants.description: Default Chromium log severity. Equivalent to INFO in most configurations.

variants.name: VERBOSE
variants.description: Most verbose logging level. Captures all internal Chromium diagnostic output.

variants.name: INFO
variants.description: Informational messages about normal engine operation.

variants.name: WARNING
variants.description: Warnings about potential issues that do not prevent operation.

variants.name: ERROR
variants.description: Error conditions that may affect engine functionality.

variants.name: FATAL
variants.description: Fatal errors that cause immediate engine termination.

variants.name: DISABLE
variants.description: Disables all native Chromium log output. Recommended for production deployments.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumLogSeverity

val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .loggingConfig { log ->
        log.severity(KromiumLogSeverity.DISABLE)
    }
    .build()
